art_note: The lifestyle campaign imagery with the model delivers a powerful luxury narrative.
desc_en: A tailored silhouette defined by a distinctive marine motif. This regular fit blazer brings effortless presence to any wardrobe. Styled with a flat lapel and functional pockets, it offers seamless versatility for formal and casual occasions. Each piece is made to order to ensure absolute exclusivity. Available with worldwide shipping.
desc_es: Una silueta sartorial definida por un distintivo motivo marino. Este blazer de corte regular aporta presencia a cualquier guardarropa. Confeccionado con solapa plana y bolsillos funcionales, ofrece versatilidad para ocasiones formales y casuales. Cada pieza se confecciona bajo demanda para garantizar exclusividad. Disponible con envío a todo el mundo.
